About this item

  • #1 Dentist recommended oral b io: This Oral-B Braun electric toothbrush delivers smooth spinning brush motion with gentle micro-vibrations; clinically proven to remove up to 100 %* more plaque along the gumline; supports teeth whitening and oral hygiene
  • Intelligent gum protection: Protect your gums from over-brushing; built-in sensor automatically slows down your speed and signals red when you brush too hard; coordinates perfectly with your mouth guard for sleep or night guards to prevent teeth grinding
  • Personalized Brushing Experience: Choose from three distinct cleaning modes—Daily Clean, Sensitive, and Whitening; round brush heads reach where rectangular manual brushes do not; promotes thorough cleaning, unlike one-speed standard brushes
  • Dentist-Recommended Coverage: The iconic round brush head masterfully reaches every corner of your mouth; unlike flat, rectangular brush heads, ensuring a comprehensive and satisfying clean with every session; reaches difficult, hard to reach spots
  • Smart Timer & Effortless Maintenance: Brush for the recommended time with a two-minute timer that alerts you every 30 seconds to change zones; fits all replacement brush heads including Ultimate Clean, Gentle Care, and Radiant White
  • Long Lasting Battery and Travel Case: Receive iO Series 2 Electric Toothbrush and a durable travel case; long lasting charge with lithium-ion battery; ideal for travel and maintaining your oral health hygiene; fits travel size toiletries bags for daily care
  • *vs. a regular manual toothbrush

Product Description

The Oral-B iO Series 2 Limited combines powerful, but gentle micro vibrations with Oral-B's dentist inspired round brush head to deliver 100% cleaner teeth versus a regular manual toothbrush. So advanced yet so simple, that you will be able to achieve that dentist clean feeling in just 1 touch of a button.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Learn more how customers reviews work on Amazon

Customers say

Customers find this electric toothbrush excellent, noting it gets teeth cleaner than basic models and is super gentle on gums. They appreciate its 3 speed settings and quieter operation compared to Sonicare, and one customer mentions it prevents germs between cleanings. The battery life and durability receive mixed reviews - while some say it charges for days and holds up nicely, others report it doesn't charge at all or only lasts two months. Additionally, customers express concerns about dust accumulation and mold growth in the device.

    A Game-Changer for My Dental Routine — Noticeable Results and Effortless to Use
    Reviewed in the United States on December 5, 2025
    Color: Pure WhiteSize: 1 Count (Pack of 1)
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

    I’ve been using this electric toothbrush for close to a year now, and I absolutely love it. Before this, I was using a regular manual toothbrush, and I truly had no idea what I was missing. The difference is enormous — this toothbrush cleans my teeth so much better and leaves my mouth feeling like I just left the dentist.

    One of the things that really convinced me it was working was my six-month dental appointment. My hygienist actually commented on how clean my teeth looked compared to previous visits. I hadn’t changed anything else in my routine except for switching to this toothbrush, so that alone made me a believer.

    It’s rechargeable, which is incredibly convenient, and the battery lasts a long time before needing to be plugged in again. The design is sleek — I have the white one, and it looks great on my bathroom counter. It also offers multiple brushing speeds, which I didn’t think I needed until I tried them. Being able to choose the intensity makes brushing feel more personalized and comfortable.

    The best part is how effortless it is to use. I don’t feel like I’m doing much of the work anymore — the toothbrush does it for me. My teeth feel cleaner with far less effort, and once you experience that, it’s hard to go back to anything else.

    Final Rating: 5 Stars — Amazing performance, noticeable results, and a must-have upgrade from a regular toothbrush.

    4 out of 5 stars
    Torn between this and the other brand
    Reviewed in the United States on August 22, 2025
    Color: Night BlackSize: 1 Count (Pack of 1)
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Been a Sonicare user for 10-15 years and decided I wanted to try the Oral B. I didn't want to spend a lot, so I found this one and ordered it.

    Things I like:

    Love circular motion of the brush instead of the up an down movement of the Sonicare.

    Love that it has a sensor to alert you if you are brushing too hard. Such a simple feature and hopefully it shows on my next dental visit.

    Battery seems to last a long time between charges. I am going on two weeks without charging which is great for travel.

    Like that the handle stays cleaner compared to my older Sonicare because of how it is designed. Toothpaste and water run down it and does not have a place to collect.

    Things I don't like:

    The brush had by design traps water whereas the Sonicare brush design seems to drain water better. I rinse my toothbrush and then lay it brush side down on a towel to let it dry before standing it up on the counter or charger. If not, I worry about it not drying fully and things growing.

    I hate that it doesn't have an auto shut off. It does vibrate every 30 seconds but it doesn't shut off. First time I used it I probably brushed for 3.5 minutes before I realized it wasn't going to turn off.

    Overall the quality doesn't seem as nice. Maybe this would be different if I had spent more money on a higher end model, but because this something I was just buying to try, I didn't want to spend a lot. If I was completely sold on this brush, I would upgrade for sure.

    I really am torn between the two brands of brushes. Now if someone would make one that has the best of both. :)

    I finally updated my old Oral B Pro electric toothbrush that I have used for 10+ years when it was on sale during Prime days. I figured why switch if it wasn’t broken. But I had noticed the charging was not what it used to be and the outer plastic felt like it was getting loose.

    I may return the Waterpik flosser my hygienist recommended for easier flossing of my back teeth. I bought it for a great price during Prime days too. I haven’t opened the box yet. About this Item

  • #1 Dentist recommended oral b io: This Oral-B Braun electric toothbrush delivers smooth spinning brush motion with gentle micro-vibrations; clinically proven to remove up to 100 %* more plaque along the gumline; supports teeth whitening and oral hygiene
  • Intelligent gum protection: Protect your gums from over-brushing; built-in sensor automatically slows down your speed and signals red when you brush too hard; coordinates perfectly with your mouth guard for sleep or night guards to prevent teeth grinding
  • Personalized Brushing Experience: Choose from three distinct cleaning modes—Daily Clean, Sensitive, and Whitening; round brush heads reach where rectangular manual brushes do not; promotes thorough cleaning, unlike one-speed standard brushes
  • Dentist-Recommended Coverage: The iconic round brush head masterfully reaches every corner of your mouth; unlike flat, rectangular brush heads, ensuring a comprehensive and satisfying clean with every session; reaches difficult, hard to reach spots
  • Smart Timer & Effortless Maintenance: Brush for the recommended time with a two-minute timer that alerts you every 30 seconds to change zones; fits all replacement brush heads including Ultimate Clean, Gentle Care, and Radiant White
  • Long Lasting Battery and Travel Case: Receive iO Series 2 Electric Toothbrush and a durable travel case; long lasting charge with lithium-ion battery; ideal for travel and maintaining your oral health hygiene; fits travel size toiletries bags for daily care
  • *vs. a regular manual toothbrush

Product Description

The Oral-B iO Series 2 Limited combines powerful, but gentle micro vibrations with Oral-B's dentist inspired round brush head to deliver 100% cleaner teeth versus a regular manual toothbrush. So advanced yet so simple, that you will be able to achieve that dentist clean feeling in just 1 touch of a button.
